Devices of the SAMPLER
===========

The measurement devices of the WATER.sampler. The devices are used in the quite complex wiki:measurement system. 
While certain devices (YSI600R, ProPS, Picarro-CoWS) can be switched off and are then ignored, 
the Mitsubishi α PCLs are crucial for the measurement.

The SDI12-Arduino and the Adcon A850 system are not part of the sampler but of the WATER.logger.
